title: azalea parvifolia
intro: Azalea parvifolia, commonly known as the white fringe tree, is a deciduous shrub or small tree that belongs to the family Ericaceae. The health benefits of Azalea parvifolia include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as an antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, making it a potential treatment for fever, respiratory issues, and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of Azalea parvifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
